name: Signal
summary: White, black, and safety yellow with square corners. Light mode only, and no focus color defined.

do: Use yellow as a fill behind black text, never as text on white.
Give yellow buttons on white a black border so their edge is visible.
dont: Don't soften the corners. The style depends on square edges.
Don't use this style for long reading pages; the display face is heavy.

provenance.author: Neat Labs
provenance.evidence: Written for this repository on 2026-09-25. Left without a dark mode, a focus color, or a section spacing value on purpose, so the site and MCP show how missing values are reported.
